content.short: A Cardano-based dApp platform for easy and secure donations with a focus on community impact and transparency.
content.description:
Do It With Lovelace is a next-generation donation platform built on Cardano, offering a simple and secure way to give back to communities in need.

With a focus on transparency and community impact, Do It With Lovelace empowers users to create and support impactful fundraising campaigns with ease.
